header.heading: Profile
header.description: Set up your profile: update your avatar, edit your info and add links to your social media to make your page more appealing to other users.

avatar.heading: Profile picture

confirmModal.heading: Remove avatar
confirmModal.message: Are you sure you want to remove your profile picture? This can't be undone.

avatar.info: Supported formats: JPG, JPEG, PNG, WEBP or GIF. Max size: 10 MB.

info.heading: Profile settings
info.usernameDescription: This is the name other users will know you by.
info.displayNameDescription: Capitalize the letters in your username however you like.
info.bioDescription: Your bio can be up to 300 characters long.

createForm.heading: Social links
createForm.titleDescription: The text shown for the link.
createForm.urlDescription: Where does this link go? Enter the full URL, for example https://github.com/username

header.heading: Account
header.description: Manage your account settings, including access, security and deactivation.
header.securityDescription: Set up two-factor authentication to better protect your data.
header.deactivationDescription: Use this option if you want to disable your account temporarily or permanently. Please read about the consequences first.

email.heading: Email address
email.emailDescription: Enter your new email address. Make sure it's valid, because a confirmation will be sent to it.

password.heading: Account password
password.oldPasswordDescription: Enter your old password to confirm it's you before changing it. This keeps your account secure.
password.newPasswordDescription: Your new password must be at least 8 characters long. Using special characters makes it more secure.

twoFactor.heading: TOTP authentication
twoFactor.description: Make your account more secure by turning on TOTP authentication. This extra layer of protection asks for a unique code, which makes unauthorized access much harder.

enable.heading: Enable TOTP
enable.qrInstructions: Scan the QR code to add TOTP
enable.pinDescription: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.

disable.heading: Are you sure you want to disable TOTP?
disable.message: Turning off TOTP authentication makes your account less secure. Are you sure you want to continue?

deactivation.heading: Deactivate account
deactivation.description: After deactivating your account, you won't be able to log in. After 7 days, your account will be deleted permanently. Until then, you can contact support to restore access and unlock your account.

confirmModal.heading: Confirm deactivation
confirmModal.message: Are you sure you want to deactivate your account? You can only restore access within 7 days.

header.heading: Appearance

theme.heading: Theme
theme.description: Choose a dark or light theme for the site

language.heading: Site language
language.description: Choose the language the site will be shown in

header.heading: Notifications
header.description: Choose how you want to get notifications from Streaming Platform. We'll let you know when channels you follow go live and when you get new followers.

siteNotifications.heading: Site notifications
siteNotifications.description: If you turn off site notifications, you won't hear about new followers on your channel or new streams.

telegramNotifications.heading: Telegram notifications
telegramNotifications.description: If you turn on Telegram notifications, your Streaming Platform account will be linked to your Telegram account. You'll get messages there about new followers, new streams, password resets and two-factor codes.

header.heading: Sessions
header.description: Sessions are the devices you use or have used to sign in to your Streaming Platform account. Here you can see the sessions that are active right now.

confirmModal.heading: Remove session
confirmModal.message: Are you sure you want to remove this session? It will be ended on that device for good, and anything running in it will stop.

header.heading: Stream keys
header.description: Generate a URL and key to start streaming.

instructionModal.heading: 🛠️ Setting up OBS for live streaming 🛠️
instructionModal.description: To start streaming, connect OBS Studio by following these steps. It only takes a few minutes, and then you're live!
instructionModal.step1Title: 🔑 Step 1: Download OBS Studio and generate your Server URL and Stream Key
instructionModal.step1Description: To stream, you need two things: a Server URL and a Stream Key. Here's how to get them:
instructionModal.downloadObsDescription: Before setting up your stream, download and install
instructionModal.copyKeys: Copy the Server URL and Stream Key
instructionModal.copyKeysDescription: After you generate them, two fields will appear: Server URL and Stream Key. Click the copy icon next to each one to copy it to your clipboard.
instructionModal.step2Description: Now that you have everything, let's set up OBS for your stream:
instructionModal.openObsDescription: If you don't have OBS yet, download it from the official website and install it. Once it starts, you'll see the main OBS window.
instructionModal.openStreamSettingsDescription: In the top menu, click File → Settings and open the Stream tab.
instructionModal.enterDetailsDescription: Under Service, choose Custom.... Paste the Server URL you copied into the Server field, and your Stream Key into the Stream Key field.
instructionModal.saveSettingsDescription: Click Apply, then OK to save your changes.
instructionModal.step3Description: OBS is set up, so you're ready to go live:
instructionModal.startStreamDescription: Go back to the main OBS window and click Start Streaming.
instructionModal.monitorStream: Keep an eye on your stream
instructionModal.monitorStreamDescription: Your stream will start in real time, and you can watch it both on the platform and in OBS.
instructionModal.congrats: ✨ All set! OBS is ready for streaming on our platform. Your viewers are waiting! 🎉

createModal.heading: Generate keys
createModal.ingressTypeDescription: Choose RTMP for regular streaming or WHIP for a WebRTC connection.

isChatFollowersOnly.heading: Followers-only chat
isChatFollowersOnly.description: When this is on, only your followers can send messages in chat.

isChatPremiumFollowersOnly.heading: Premium followers-only chat
isChatPremiumFollowersOnly.description: When this is on, only your premium followers can send messages in chat.

createForm.priceDescription: Set the price of your plan. This is what users will pay for the subscription.
